description: This file defines the 'Member' class and related functions for managing members, subscriptions, and customers in a non-profit ERP system, including setup of payment subscriptions via Razorpay.

classes.name: Member
classes.description: Represents a member in the non-profit system, with methods for loading data, validation, and setting up payment subscriptions.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Loads address and contact information when the member document is loaded.

methods.name: setup_subscription
methods.description: Sets up a payment subscription via Razorpay.

methods.name: make_customer_and_link
methods.description: Creates a customer record and links it to the member.
